model: Axis A = own as component (promote/wrap/adopt-existing); Axis B = conform to look (mandatory for all). rule-of-2 trips a pattern onto the radar.

candidates.pattern: Empty/error plane richer than a single line (title+description, optional icon/CTA; action-less error)
candidates.donorTarget: extend StateView (empty: title+description+icon+action; error: optional retry)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-06-15: StateView gained `title` (foreground headline) + `description` props, shared across empty + error variants. `message` retained as the back-compat alias for the single muted line. Biggest single cluster — brickshop alone deferred ~8 two-line empties. Colored-empty `tone` deliberately left out (no semantic-color evidence yet).

candidates.pattern: Route/list-shaped skeleton loader (animate-pulse rows) instead of a spinner
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 as the first Component-kind archetype (Sk, skeleton-loader): ListSkeleton (rows/columns/showHeader/avatar + role=status/aria-busy/sr-only label) composing the Skeleton atom, plus a non-breaking StateView `loadingSkeleton` override. Authored FRESH, not lifted: the 'hk-crm ready donor' premise did not hold — hk-crm deleted its hand-rolled list-skeleton (commit e2bc720) and moved to the text StateView; the real driver is brickshop's ~40 uncoordinated inline copies (5 shapes, no shared component, no a11y). Relaxed the absolute 'no skeleton screens' rule (README + list-with-detail/settings-table/grouped-list) to conditional: text is default, skeleton permitted where row shape is known.

candidates.pattern: Editable control sitting flush inside a table/grid cell (number/text/select)
candidates.donorTarget: CellInput / CellSelect (thin wrappers over Input/Select, flush-cell styling + focus-visible ring)
candidates.axisB: must carry the standard focus ring
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-06-15 as ui/cell-input (CellInput + CellSelect). Projects now adopt it (brickshop record-list inline-cell rows unblocked).

candidates.pattern: Compact/clearable/mobile search box (h-6/h-12, clear-X, match counter, inputMode)
candidates.donorTarget: extend SearchInput (size, clearable, input passthrough props)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-06-15. SearchInput now takes inputSize (sm/default/lg), clearable (trailing X), count (counter slot), and full native-input passthrough (inputMode…). Default render unchanged. Projects adopt it instead of hand-rolling compact/mobile/clearable boxes.

candidates.donorTarget: ColorField / FileField (wrap the native control so it is shared AND on-token)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 as ui/color-field (ColorField) + ui/file-field (FileField). ColorField = boxed native swatch + paired editable hex Input on one value/onChange; FileField = hidden native input + button/dropzone trigger, built-in input.value='' reset, maxSizeBytes gate, and optional name+size+clear row (real drag-and-drop left out — one-off in the fleet). The only true shadcn gap — closed by wrapping, not exempting.

candidates.pattern: Chronological media/event <ul> feed (NOT a record list)
candidates.donorTarget: FeedItem / archetype H (already in the donor)
candidates.notes: Correctly not a <Table>; but the donor already owns the feed molecule — adopt it rather than leave raw.

candidates.pattern: Filter toolbar: pill row with synthetic 'all' + labeled filter caption above a control
candidates.notes: Distinct from SegmentedControl (mode toggle). Confirm a 2nd consumer (controlling-app/brickshop filter toolbars) before promoting.

candidates.pattern: Colored/semantic icon circle (accent/status), not the muted entity avatar
candidates.donorTarget: IconAvatar `tone` prop (or a separate accent-circle molecule)
candidates.notes: brickshop terminated the IconAvatar sweep because all its circles are colored-accent. Confirm rule-of-2.

candidates.pattern: Non-row contextual/overflow menu (tab-strip menu, custom-trigger status menu needing event access)
candidates.donorTarget: possible RowActionsMenu sibling, or a generic ActionMenu with custom trigger + onSelect event access
candidates.notes: RowActionsMenu is row-specific; these need a custom trigger / event access. Evaluate a sibling primitive.

candidates.pattern: Hand-rolled labeled native field:
candidates.donorTarget: NativeField (archetype I, component kind) — the labeled-field assembly (label + control + hint + error + a11y) composing Input/Textarea/Label, plus a tokenized range slider
candidates.axisB: on-token (rides shared field chrome + accent-primary range)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 as the second Component-kind archetype (I, raw-input): NativeField. The <input\b scan splits into already-solved gaps (file->FileField, color->ColorField, cell->CellInput), adoption debt (text/checkbox/select where a primitive exists or the repo has none), and the genuinely un-homed shape this promotes: the labeled-native-field triad with the universal fleet gap being accessibility (no label association / aria-invalid / aria-describedby), plus native-only types with no shadcn wrapper (mistra's range x4, date/time). Scoped to the standalone labeled field: booleans stay Checkbox/Switch, enums stay Select, grid cells stay CellInput. scanSignal kept as 'raw-input' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.

candidates.pattern: Raw <label> hand-rolled + control (incl. non-native Select), no htmlFor/aria wiring — the label-side view of the un-homed labeled-field triad
candidates.donorTarget: NativeField (archetype I, raw-input) — the labeled-field assembly closes the label-association a11y gap this signal tracks
candidates.axisB: token parity with the shared field chrome
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 via archetype I (raw-input / NativeField) — the SAME molecule the 'raw-input' candidate promotes, tracked here from the complementary '<label' scan angle (a raw <label> around a Select has no bare <input>, so the raw-input scan alone would miss it). A separate 'field' promotion (Fd) was drafted from this signal and dropped as a duplicate once raw-input merged first (one archetype owns the shape). RESIDUAL: NativeField deliberately scopes OUT enum controls ('enums stay Select'), so the label+wiring assembly around a shadcn Select — the dominant raw-label shape in controlling-app's filter toolbars — is now covered by archetype S (raw-select / SelectField), promoted 2026-07-24 — the labeled enum-field assembly with the a11y wiring this label-side signal tracks. (Resolved as its own sibling archetype rather than a NativeField slot: SelectField owns the enum control, NativeField the native input.) scanSignal kept as 'raw-label' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking <label> regressions.

candidates.pattern: Labeled multi-line text field re-hand-composed at every call site (label + textarea + helper/error), + optional char-count and mono/JSON variant
candidates.donorTarget: TextareaField (archetype T) — Label + Textarea atom + helper/error slot + optional showCount threshold counter + mono variant
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 as Component-kind archetype T (raw-textarea): TextareaField composes the shadcn Textarea + Label atoms, binding-neutral (useState or RHF), with opt-in maxLength char-counter (muted->amber->destructive) and mono/JSON variant. No auto-resize built — fleet-wide search for scrollHeight/field-sizing/auto-resize came back empty. Field composition met rule-of-2 across all 7 projects; mono variant across controlling-app + mistra; counter a repeated idiom within brickshop.

candidates.pattern: Hand-rolled labeled enum field:
candidates.donorTarget: SelectField (archetype S, component kind) — the labeled enum-field assembly (label + choice control + hint + error + a11y) composing the shadcn Select + Label, with options as {value,label}[] data
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-24 as the enum sibling of I (raw-input) and T (raw-textarea): archetype S (raw-select / SelectField). Closes the RESIDUAL the raw-label entry flagged when raw-input scoped enums OUT — the label+wiring assembly around a Select. Fleet is genuinely split native <select> (my-finance ~34 sites 100% native, mistra 11 files, dashboard 2, brickshop CellSelect) vs shadcn <Select> (controlling + brickshop all-shadcn), so the contract is control-agnostic and the baseline binds to the canonical shadcn Select. Universal gap closed: label association (aria-labelledby — Radix trigger is a button, htmlFor won't associate), aria-invalid, aria-describedby, and a standardized placeholder/none affordance (real option, not a __none__ sentinel). Options carried as {value,label}[] data — the convention no fleet project reached (all pass <option>/<SelectItem> markup per site). Scoped OUT: multiselect, combobox/cmdk, async-search, filter-bar label-less selects, and the flush grid-cell select (CellSelect sibling). scanSignal kept as 'raw-select' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.
